units: x=left/W, y=top/H (from the top), size=side/min(W,H); W,H = source pixel size; pixel square = (x*W, y*H, side, side) with side = size*min(W,H); pad=true: the square overhangs the picture's short side, transparent there

C08.note: subject wider than the largest square; crop cuts 16% of the subject mass

C139.note: subject spans the whole canvas, crop ~ full image (0.98)

C34.note: subject spans most of the canvas, crop 0.96 of the image; busy at small size, 90 fine dark marks

C46.note: subject spans most of the canvas, crop 0.85 of the image

C50.note: subject spans most of the canvas, crop 0.86 of the image
